tasks.title: Concert mode inline sheet toggle
tasks.prompt: In ConcertModeScreen, add a local bool state (_showSheet, default false). The existing lyrics icon (top-left, which currently pushes PerformanceSheetScreen) must instead toggle _showSheet, shown only when the active song hasSheetContent, with a tooltip. When _showSheet is true and the active song has sheet content, render PerformanceSheetView inline (same constructor usage as lib/screens/songs/song_page_screen.dart ~line 321) INSTEAD of the big BPM _Readout, keyed by ValueKey(song.id), with bpm and sections from the active song. Never pass any import-lyrics/empty-state callback and never mutate song.sections. When the active song changes to one without sheet content, fall back to the BPM readout. The bottom _Controls (prev/next/play/nudges) must stay visible in both modes. Keep wakelock/immersive handling untouched. Do not touch PerformanceSheetView or PerformanceSheetScreen. Match existing MonoPulse tokens and style. Remove the now-unused PerformanceSheetScreen import if unused.
tasks.verify: dart analyze lib/screens/concert_mode_screen.dart && ! rg -q 'PerformanceSheetScreen' lib/screens/concert_mode_screen.dart && rg -q 'PerformanceSheetView' lib/screens/concert_mode_screen.dart && rg -q '_showSheet' lib/screens/concert_mode_screen.dart
